sections.heading: SPECIALIZATION IN GEOGRAPHY AND ENVIRONMENT
lines: Faculty of Social Science - Geography and Environment

Completion of first-year requirements, including 1.0 course from Geography and Environment 1100, Geography and Environment 1200A/B, Geography and Environment 1300A/B, Geography and Environment 1400F/G, Geography and Environment 1500F/G, Environmental Science 1021F/G, with a mark of at least 60% in each of these courses.

If upper-year students have not completed 1.0 courses listed above, they may select one or two courses from: Geography and Environment 2131A/B, Geography and Environment 2132A/B, Geography and Environment 2133A/B, Geography and Environment 2152F/G, and/or Geography and Environment 2153A/B in making up the 1.0 admission requirement, as long as they were completed with a grade of at least 60%. Senior qualifying entry course(s) cannot be counted for subsequent program credit.
0.5 course: Geography and Environment 2210A/B* (normally taken in Year 2).
1.5 courses: Geography and Environment 2220A/B, Geography and Environment 3250A/B, Geography and Environment 4000A/B.
1.0 course from: Geography and Environment 2411F/G, Geography and Environment 2412F/G, Geography and Environment 2420A/B, Geography and Environment 2430A/B, Geography and Environment 2460F/G.
1.0 course from: Geography and Environment 2310A/B, Geography and Environment 2320A/B, Geography and Environment 2330A/B.
1.0 course from: Geography and Environment courses numbered 2000 to 2199.
4.0 courses from: Geography and Environment at the 2200 level or above, at least 2.0 of which must be at the 3000 level or above.
* If an antirequisite Statistics course has been taken instead, then an additional 0.5 course in Geography and Environment must be taken to make up the 9.0 courses required for the module.
This module may NOT be combined with any other Geography and Environment module.
